const body = $('Signup Webhook').first().json.body || $('Signup Webhook').first().json;
const baseProfile = $('Build Base Profile Data').first().json;

return [{
  json: {
    user_id:          baseProfile.user_id,
    submission_key:   baseProfile.submission_key,
    full_name:        baseProfile.full_name,
    license_number:   body.license_number || body.license_id || null,
    certification:    body.certification || null,
    department:       body.department || body.specialization || null,
    state:            baseProfile.state,
    phone_number:     body.phone_number || null,
    hospital_affiliation: body.hospital_affiliation || null,
    years_of_experience:  body.years_of_experience || null,
    government_id:          body.government_id || null,
    government_id_status:   body.government_id_status || 'pending',
    annual_license:         body.annual_license || null,
    annual_license_status:  body.annual_license_status || 'pending',
    nursing_degree:         body.nursing_degree || null,
    nursing_degree_status:  body.nursing_degree_status || 'pending',
    verified_by_admin: false,
    verification_notes: null
  }
}];

// BUG FIX: Was using data.id (wrong key) and sub_${data.id} (wrong key format).
// Now reads from Build Base Profile Data directly for correct user_id and submission_key.
const baseProfile = $('Build Base Profile Data').first().json;

return [{
  json: {
    user_id:        baseProfile.user_id,
    submission_key: baseProfile.submission_key,   // Correct EE_<hex32> format
    full_name:      baseProfile.full_name || null,

    // Identity & Demographics
    dob:              null,
    gender:           null,
    blood_group:      null,
    genotype:         null,
    language:         null,
    marital_status:   null,
    religion:         null,
    nationality:      null,
    address:          null,
    occupation_cat:   null,
    living_situation: null,

    // Emergency Contact
    ec_name:         null,
    ec_phone:        null,
    ec_secondary:    null,
    ec_relationship: null,

    // Medical Conditions
    conditions:        [],
    cond_other:        null,
    fam_history:       [],
    fam_history_notes: null,

    // Surgeries
    surgeries:  [],
    surg_other: null,

    // Medications
    rx_meds:     [],
    otc_meds:    [],
    herbal_meds: [],
    meds_notes:  null,

    // Allergies
    drug_allergies:  [],
    food_allergies:  [],
    other_allergies: null,

    // Immunisations
    immunisations: [],
    imm_notes:     null,

    // Transfusion
    transfusion:         null,
    transfusion_details: null,

    // Mental Health
    mental_history: [],
    mental_current: null,
    cognitive:      [],
    mental_notes:   null,

    // Directives
    directives: [],
    dir_notes:  null,

    // Admission History
    admit:         null,
    admit_details: null,

    // Lifestyle
    smoking:           null,
    alcohol:           null,
    substance_use:     [],
    substance_details: null,
    diet:              null,
    exercise_freq:     null,
    pets:              null,
    pets_type:         [],
    pets_other:        null,
    lifestyle_notes:   null,

    // Assistive Devices
    assistive:       [],
    assistive_notes: null,

    // OB/GYN
    gravida:                 null,
    para:                    null,
    miscarriages:            null,
    last_menstrual_period:   null,
    menstrual_regularity:    null,
    contraceptive_use:       null,
    menopause:               null,
    pregnancy_complications: [],
    obgyn_notes:             null
  }
}];
